name: Shishir
what: A Bangla-first online skincare store for Bangladesh where shoppers pick a routine, order with cash on delivery, and get a photo of the actual box with batch and expiry before paying.
hard_part: Built around proof instead of reviews: no ratings or fake stock counts, and the catalogue is generated from the supplier list by a build script rather than edited by hand. Bangla is the default with a Bangla calendar and six seasons on the home page, delivery zones for all 64 districts, and orders go to a small self-hosted order service with its own status pipeline.
